reviews.text: Had an appointment at the Lauriston Road vets, really easy to book the appointment, was seen to on time and very happy with the advise. Not too stressful for my cat as it's right on our doorstep.
Lovely staff !professional, warm and welcoming!!!
All very welcoming and assuring. Morgan treated with care, professionalism and cuddles, plus a treat or two😊 …

I was impressed with how good these ladies were with my puppy. I felt they looked after him and I could tell he felt safe while they did there stuff including jabs and chip. He didn't even notice the jabs or chip going in. These guys know what there doing.
Really friendly and caring team with responsive staff making it easy to get prescriptions filled.

Amazing service and very quick response. We got an appointment only the next day for our new kitten. Lily our cat was still nervous with new environment but Dr at Columbia Road are very gentle and sweet. Lily got amazing time there even with treat. I couldn't thanks the doctor enough for looking after our baby for her first time at a vet! Many many thanks. I highly recommend Hello Vet to everyone!

Lovely staff and a team that was very welcoming. No waiting time, and Emma did a great job and was such a caring and attentive doctor. The price for our check up was reasonable and we’ll definitely come back for all our vet needs. Cheers!

Hello Caillin, 
Thank you for leaving us this 5 star rating, we really appreciate it!
Best wishes, Hannah
Good and caring service, really happy to have found them
Very friendly and efficient care provided to my small breed dog.

Everyone here was so friendly and caring, making me and my cat feel like we were in safe hands. Great value too and lots of little touches that make the experience nice such as whatsapp. Parking also close by and opening hours very convenient!

The service is both incredibly quick and friendly! The check ins on my cat’s health and well being after his procedure was so considerate, and their communication is the best I’ve ever had with any service. I would, and have recommended to friends and family!

Dear Thiago, thanks so much for leaving us a positive rating! It's much appreciated. Have a fab week, 
Your Hello Vet team

In the 5 years I’ve had my cat, I’ve never seen a vet clinic with full 5 stars before. And let me tell you, I’d give 10 stars if it was possible. I’ve never felt so cared for as cat parent, the online chat is amazing, everyone who works here is incredibly caring, helpful and genuinely interested in making your and your pets experience as comfortable as possible. My cat Lucifer is going through a flare up of his FIC, for the first time in ages, and it’s been an incredibly stressful time for me, but these guys are genuinely amazing, lucifer is getting better and I can’t recommend them enough!
Wonderful friendly and informative service

I could not be more grateful for the care my two cats, Lilou and Salem, receive at Hello Vet. The whole team is exceptionally knowledgeable, thorough and compassionate. Dr Christian, Dr Joe and Dr Olivia have each shown outstanding dedication in managing complex, ongoing conditions with real attention to detail and a level of care that goes far beyond what I ever expected from a veterinary practice.

They take the time to explain test results clearly, propose thoughtful treatment plans, and always make sure I feel supported, even during more stressful episodes with my cats’ health. The nursing and client care teams are equally wonderful, consistently kind, responsive and genuinely invested in the wellbeing of their patients.

It is rare to find a practice where clinical expertise and empathy are so perfectly combined. I feel very fortunate to have Hello Vet looking after Lilou and Salem, and I recommend them wholeheartedly.
Friendly team with professional services

Dear Sebastian,
thanks so much for leaving us a positive rating! It's much appreciated. Sending lots of love to you, 🐈 Mathilda and 🐕‍🦺 Isabel!
Your Hello Vet team …

Dear Mariam, 
thanks so much for leaving us a positive rating! 
Have a fab week & lovely festive season,
Your Hello Vet team

Zahra's first vet visit was so smooth and pleasant for her. I'd highly recommend them. All the staff are extremely attentive and caring. The space also doesn't feel like a clinical vets but actually feels lovey and warm to be in.
Lovely small clinic, was able to get a same day appointment which was really helpful. The team was nice and understanding. I would really recommend :)
Had such a lovely experience as a first time cat owner, all the staff were brilliant and accommodating!
Friendly staff, lovely clean clinic, easy booking system and staff are available over WhatsApp for further ease of asking follow-up questions. A great vet that I’d recommend for anyone in the area.

Dear Daniel, 
thanks so much for the positive rating! We are glad you and Cornelius had a positive experience at our practice. If you need anything else, you know where to find us! Lots of love, 
Your Hello Vet team

My small senior dog typically gets incredibly anxious when heading to the vet. We arrived and the environment was clean and comfortable and my fur baby had no idea we were at a vet clinic until the stethoscope came out! The Dr we saw was incredible patient towards my dog and so kind to me with my endless questions. Pricing is competitive to other clinics and they give honest advice on things like food brands and medication purchases

The Columbia Road HELLO VET was a wonderful discovery. It was my cat, Louie’s, first visit to a vet since I adopted her, so we were both a bit nervous. Everyone there was so welcoming, from the initial contact to follow-up discussions on WhatsApp. They even helped explain my pet insurance (a new thing for me). It was a routine check-up and yearly injection, but there was time for Louie to relax and have her claws trimmed, which was much appreciated. After the appointment, I had follow-up conversations on WhatsApp with the staff to ensure Louie was okay, which went beyond my expectations. I was genuinely touched by their kindness and attention. I am so glad I found them.

I’m so glad we found Hello Vet. I immediately knew our new puppy was in safe hands.   Really friendly, helpful and reassuring staff and excellent service and care. It is really easy to ask questions and get answers over WhatsApp. I can’t recommend highly enough.

I took my puppy here to get her vaccinations and mircochipping and they have really good pricing there too i would recommend to other if they would prefer private vets for there pets they only do dogs and cats
Thank very much for be so kind To Tiger and my self
Great service and lovely team! So great to have the lovely locations in the area.

We recently moved from New York and feel very lucky to have found HelloVet. The team is incredibly friendly and made us feel welcome right away. Communication through WhatsApp is super convenient, and scheduling an appointment was quick and easy. Our French Bulldog Oliver—who normally gets very anxious at the vet—was surprisingly calm during the visit, which says a lot about the environment and care here. Highly recommend!
Excellent services, super practices. Would recommend!
Parking is an issue, other than that the service is excellent, staff also very good and cooperative.

Hi Clare, 
Thank you for the 5 stars - we really appreciate it! Have a lovely week, your Hello Vet team
Excellent care from empathetic vets and friendly, caring support staff. Convenient located all across the neighbourhood.
Great comms and experience, especially with our grumpy and anxious dog.

What a brilliant vet practice! Honestly can’t recommend the team highly enough. Kind, sweet and super informed vets who go above and beyond to find the right treatment for the animals and clearly really love their jobs. Everyone we’ve dealt with has been great. They fit us in last minute around travel plans and offered really clear advice to help everything go smoothly. Our cats love it there and the environment is so calming! Never a bother for them to go and get such a fuss from the team. Prices are super reasonable for the quality of care, prompt responses and thorough courses of investigation.

Fantastic and prompt service. Was really responsive to my Luna's needs and put her at ease. Very convenient having so many sites in the same area, as you can always guarantee a quick appointment. Very reassuring team.

Absolutely fantastic experience at Hello Vet on Columbia Road! The staff is warm, professional, and genuinely caring — they took amazing care of my puppy and made us both feel completely at ease. The vet was thorough, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all my questions. The clinic is clean, modern, and clearly run with a lot of love for animals. Highly recommend to any pet owner looking for top-notch care. Thank you, Hello Vet — we’re so glad to have found you!

Amazing first visit with my dog the other day. The receptionist was super friendly and warm. The vet was equally so and helped us find a solution for my dog’s health concern. The place itself is fresh, clean and stylish. I think what I loved most was the written report delivered via WhatsApp after the appointment so you don’t have to remember/make notes during the appointment. They also give automated vaccination reminders. And gave Milo a cute bag of treats after the appt with her name handwritten. 10/10.

Just wanted to take a moment to say thank you for the amazing work you do! My cat Gigi’ always stresses a lot when has to go to the Vet.
I’ve read the previous reviews and since it’s only a 5 min walk to my house I’ve decided to go to Hello Vet Columbia road.
I was really surprised to see that Gigi was really calm and collaborative, the doctor really knew how to deal with her, spent quite a bit of time visiting her and talked to me clearly about what she thought.
She gave medications and provided me with the kit for a urine test.
I left the place very happy knowing that I have a trustable vet only a short walk from my house.
Obviously we don’t want to see you often 😆, but thank you for your help!

Friendly and caring staff on the phone and in the clinic, i was able to make an appointment the same day and was in and out within about 10 minutes. The WhatsApp chat option to liaise with a vet nurse is super helpful too.

Took our puppy McFluffy to Hello Vet Columbia Road for his vaccination and had a great experience. The vet was very professional and welcoming, and the receptionist was super friendly and kind. They’re available on WhatsApp for advice any time, which is incredibly convenient and reassuring. The whole visit was smooth, and I really feel confident having them care for McFluffy. Highly recommended!

Hello vet is great, their prices are very fair and they are super easy to get appointments with. The care they provide via WhatsApp is amazing too. My dog is always at ease in their clinics and the staff are so kind and friendly

I brought my dog in without an appointment because he had half pulled a nail out.  We were seen by a vet within half an hour of it happening. The nail was pulled off and his foot was thoroughly cleaned and well bandaged.  The treatment was excellent and it healed well. I would not hesitate to take him back if he does anything in the future. He is a nervous dog so not easy to handle but they looked after him very well.
Dr Sorcha was amazing ! She took very good care of us  and was very kind to our cat I am very happy that we definitely found her ! Thank you x

Highly recommend Hello vet, Hackney. Been to a few other vets and none were as good as this one. The team were amazing and looked after my cat exceptionally. Every question was answered and managed to get an appointment immediately via WhatsApp.

Such a great experience. Everyone is really kind, caring and patient. You get the impression that everyone loves animals, their job and their colleagues.
Always on hand for advice and no judgement.
Transparent and understanding.
I have a 5 month old puppy but I know she’ll be in the best hands as she gets older.

So impressed by this vet practice! We were able to get a same day appointment and even same day blood test.  The vet Dr Holly and the nursing team were amazing, and listened to all of concerns and took such great care of our cat. Everything is really seamless and easy to navigate, from making an appointment, to receiving the bill via email and being able to ask follow up questions on WhatsApp. Highly recommend, I immediately registered my dog there as well.
Super friendly and professional

Hello Vet is a lovely space with a welcoming team and excellent service. The vet was brilliant with my cat, offered clear advice and answered all my questions. The experience overall was great.

I also really enjoy the ability to ask questions and book appointments through WhatsApp.
Really lovely new clinic. The vet we saw was really friendly, reassuring and knowledgable! Would recommend :)

So happy this vet has opened! Their WhatsApp service makes it really convenient and easy to book appointments and the best and most attentive aftercare I’ve experienced at a Vet. The staff were super friendly, helpful and they genuinely care so much about their service. Reasonable prices too. Couldn’t recommend this place more highly and glad to have a trusted reliable vet just around the corner 🧡
If you haven’t had this cuisine before then you need to try. Amazing service, unreal food - very authentic flavours. Plus great wine. 10/10

A huge thank you to Holly Davis (vet nurse) for being so kind, patient, sweet and thorough in explaining everything during Cookie’s first vaccine. She was incredibly caring, and it really put both me and Cookie at ease. They even gave him treats afterwards, and he felt so comfortable!

The receptionist was also lovely and friendly, which made the whole visit even better.

The practice itself is clean and modern, and their responsiveness on the chat is super helpful. I’m extremely pleased with their service—it’s so nice to see a team of young professionals who are truly dedicated and caring toward our furry babies.

Highly recommended!!

Our first time here. The staff are brilliant they put us and our cat Henry at ease and did a good job.

Henry's Hoomans

Hi Emma,
Thank you for the 5 stars. We hope to see you again!
Best wishes,
Hannah
Very nice staff and always seen on time.

They were so great and kind with my little one from the very first greeting point to every other of our needs. Mi little one was so calm when she got home like nothing happened, appetite was great and the recovery with no issues. Hands down best place for your furry loved ones 😻 …

The vets at hellovet have been amazingly helpful. When our cat was poorly they gave a same day appointment and followed up a few days later to make sure he was on the mend. Couldn’t recommend the hellovet more!

After recently moving to east london, I was a little reluctant about registering with a new vet after being with our vet in South london for 2 years - but I couldn’t have made a better decision.
My pup was as happy as larry at her appointment. despite needing two lots of medication, she seemed so calm and at home. The pick and mix bag of treats was a hit too.
Her wound cleared in 7 days and shes back to normal! They also checked in every 2 days on whatsapp, requesting follow up pictures, wondering how Mila was feeling. The little things that mean the most!
Had a great experience with Dr Holly. Easy to get an appointment and excellent location. Highly recommend!

Hi, 
Thank you for leaving us 5 stars, it's really appreciated. 
If you need anything else, please do get in touch!
Have a lovely weekend - Hannah

Really grateful for this place. It's so close to where I live, and my senior cat gets traumatised every time we need to leave the apartment. I'm grateful for them - they picked up on a condition that could have gotten far worse if left untreated. He's now happy, a lot more energetic and so much better than he was a week ago. The staff were so kind, and treated my sweet Leo so well, making sure that he was as comfortable as possible (he's a very nervous cat). The Whatsapp system makes it so easy to not only schedule appointments, but even to check in and give updates. The whole experience was seamless and reasonably priced. It's also so nice to meet people who genuinely seem to like what they do. Would definitely recommend.
Very modern clinic, friendly and experienced staff. Overall had a great experience, can’t recommend enough!
Hi very please with the care susie received and very friendly atmosphere. Made susie calm and ourselves  Thank you

Amazing service and attention. I took my two fur babies for the annual check up, they had been seen by other vet but Hello Vet opened closer to my house and though to give them a try and I’m very happy I did! They really cared about them, very thorough check up, on time and they sent different follow up messages and emails to see how they were doing. Great experience and we will continue with them as my regular vets for my two cats. Very happy with the overall experience, treatment and customer service, plus the physical place itself is lovely as well! Would recommend it to everyone!
nice simple and friendly me and coco love it !
I visited Hellovet today and I was impressed with the staff and welcome I received. Very friendly and helpful, thankyou!

I went there just for a routine check and vaccination and really enjoyed the place! The vet was super nice, treated my cat Leon really well too. I also visited their London Fields branch and had an equal positive experience- the clinic is very modern and the vets are really caring and good too.

It's so wonderful to have found a local vet that care as much about our pets as we do. Having lived in the area for over 20 years I have struggled to find a vet I felt I could trust - my last one I vowed never to go back to!   I first visited the London Fields branch of Hello Vet  to register and was extremely impressed, but was so pleased when the Columbia Rd clinic opened as, for me, so much more convenient.  From the moment you enter you are greeted with a friendly smile, care & attention and an obvious love of animals. I cannot recommend Hello Vet enough and I know Gus will be taken care of in the best possible way should he need anything. I'm very very happy.
It was very pleasant, I'm glad, I found a vet I can trust
